summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in a frustrating encounter where they created numerous chances but couldn't convert them when it mattered. Saul Shotton's fine far post volley gave them hope late on, but it proved too little too late as they were undone by soft free kicks and poor defensive marking in the first half. The Bach will be looking to bounce back quickly when they travel to Stafford Town on Saturday.
